_comment: Product stage: one real photo per ingredient, shown as a full-height panel on the side opposite the text. 'position' = CSS object-position (which part of the photo stays visible). Current photos: Unsplash License (free for commercial use, no attribution required — credited here anyway). To swap one, drop a new file in /public/assets/stage and change 'src'. If any 'src' is empty the old 3D scene is used instead. Optional dim (0-1) darkens a photo behind text-heavy sections.
